text: Addendum No. 1 dated August 3, 2026: from October 7, 2026, the unit price of Meeting Catering (package) is changed to IDR 1,458,000.00 per unit.
Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 14 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank CIMB Niaga, number 296906444999, in the name of Coral Foods Group.
Late payment accrues interest of 1% per month on the overdue amount.
